summary: Feature 26 'Mark as sent to employer' funnel loop-closer - full backend + frontend E2E verification. Backend pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_job_search_mark_applied.py) 7/7 PASSED in 7.34s covering the complete idempotency contract: (1) POST /api/job-search/applications/mark-applied unauth returns 401/403; (2) nonexistent job_id returns 404; (3) untracked open job -> creates status='applied', changed:true, persisted (GET verified); (4) saved -> applied advances with history ['saved','applied'], changed:true; (5) already 'applied' -> changed:false, status:'applied' (no-op); (6) 'interview' NOT downgraded -> changed:false, status:'interview' (verified via GET post-call). Frontend Playwright E2E via preview URL admin cookie-login OK -> /job-search -> Documents step -> (a) initial state 'Already tracked as Applied' banner rendered under Document studio (changed:false path); (b) reset principal job to 'saved' via PATCH, click job-search-doc-download-btn -> prompt (job-search-mark-applied-prompt) visible with i18n copy 'Sent this kit to an employer? Mark the job as Applied in your tracker.' -> click job-search-mark-applied-btn -> job-search-mark-applied-msg shows 'Moved to Applied in your tracker.' (changed:true path) -> prompt hidden -> Tracker tab shows 2 APPLIED status chips; (c) session dedup verified - 2nd .md click for same job does NOT re-open prompt (markedJobIds guard); (d) after reload+reset, Download .pdf (job-search-doc-download-pdf-btn) opens prompt; (e) after reload+reset, Send kit to my email (job-search-email-kit-btn) opens prompt; (f) dismiss X (job-search-mark-applied-dismiss) hides prompt AND tracker status remains 'saved' (no downgrade, no mutation) - GET verified. Tracker regression testids all present: job-search-tracker-row-{i}, job-search-tracker-remove-{i}, job-search-tracker-set-{saved|interview|offer|rejected}-{i}. Environmental 429s appeared during rapid PDF/email chained clicks but did not affect correctness - paced with ~75s backoff between phases as noted in review.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/job_search.py::mark_application_applied (lines 556-594) implements the contract correctly and tersely: require_auth first (401 path), _get_open_job for 404, single find_one with _id excluded, non-'saved' short-circuit returning current status with changed:false (never downgrades applied/interview/offer/rejected), saved->applied uses $set+$push atomic update, untracked path builds full app_doc with history seeded to 'applied'. No race conditions since Mongo update is atomic and there's no upsert (existing check gates creation). Timestamp precision: _now_iso() called twice in the saved->applied update ($set updated_at and $push at) - identical values in practice but could be captured once for strict monotonicity if audit trails care.

/app/frontend/src/components/jobSearch/DocumentsTab.tsx: promptMarkApplied (line 75-79) correctly guards with markedJobIds.includes(jobId) so session dedup prevents re-nagging after a successful Mark. However dismiss X only clears markPromptJobId (line 276-283) and does NOT add to markedJobIds - by design (user may want to dismiss and re-consider later). Verified: after dismiss X, next .md/pdf/email will re-open the prompt on reload but not in the same in-memory session because the calling handlers only invoke promptMarkApplied on action, and the state remains ''; verified behavior matches implementation. markApplied (line 81-101) correctly branches i18n string on data.changed and calls onApplied() to refresh tracker+summary - verified live via tracker chip refresh.

/app/frontend/app/job-search.tsx line 153 onApplied wiring bumps trackerRefreshSignal AND calls loadSummary - both observed in the tracker view showing 2 APPLIED chips and summary card TRACKED APPLICATIONS=2 after mark.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_job_search_mark_applied.py (NEW - 7 pytest cases covering full mark-applied contract: 401/403 unauth, 404 nonexistent, untracked->applied (create+changed:true+GET verify), saved->applied (advance+history+changed:true+GET verify), already-applied no-op (changed:false), interview not-downgraded (changed:false + GET status still interview), plus cleanup fixture restoring apps to 'applied')

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 E2E paths verified: .md->prompt->Mark->'Moved to Applied' + tracker APPLIED chips; already-applied 'Already tracked as Applied' msg; session dedup no re-prompt same job; .pdf triggers prompt; email kit triggers prompt; dismiss X hides prompt without tracker mutation)

All acceptance criteria satisfied end-to-end: idempotent create/advance contract holds, never downgrades, history preserved, 401/404 guards, prompt UI appears after all three actions (.md/.pdf/email), Mark shows correct i18n message per changed:true/false branch, tracker+summary auto-refresh, session dedup prevents duplicate nagging, dismiss X is a pure UI no-op with zero tracker side effects.
